note: Rules every county inherits unless its own file says otherwise. County files hold only their differences.

deadlines.note: Estimates. The packet gives only the 48-hour packet rule; an office deadline in a message overrides these.

schedule_changes.source_text: Only the government can approve a hearing date change. The firm, consultants and homeowners can request a change, but moving a calendar event does not move the hearing.

packet.source_text: Send current case packet to the clerk and consultant at least 48 hours before the hearing. Late material requires clerk confirmation.
packet.clerk_evidence_note: receipt = the gate closes only when the clerk confirms a readable packet (message 34 shows a sent file that could not be opened). sent_on_time = for an office that never sends receipts, an on-time send is enough; late material still needs the clerk.

autonomy_note: L0 = draft only, a person sends. L1 = one-click approval. L2 = sends automatically and logs. 'human' = a task only a person can do.

timers.note: Estimates. How long silence is tolerated before a reminder: never longer than a third of the time left before the deadline, counted in office hours for offices, and not at night for consultants unless the deadline is under 24 hours away. After max_reminders a person calls.
